howToRegisterForEvent.question: How do I register for an event?
howToRegisterForEvent.answer: Open any event on the marketplace and choose Register now for your category. The wizard walks you through sign-in (if needed), waivers, optional add-ons, organizer fields, and payment—or instant confirmation for free categories. Your registration and QR code appear in My registrations once confirmed.

groupFamilyRegistration.question: Can I register multiple people in one order?
groupFamilyRegistration.answer: Yes. On the event page, use Register family / group to add up to the event's per-order limit (usually 10). Include yourself, link participants who already have Atleita accounts, or add guests without accounts. One checkout covers the whole order and sends confirmation emails to each participant.

guestRegistrationClaim.question: I was registered as a guest—how do I claim my spot?
guestRegistrationClaim.answer: If someone registered you as a guest, you'll get a confirmation email with a Claim my registration link. Sign in or create a Atleita account with the same email—the app links the registration to your profile. After that, the registration shows in your portal with your QR code.

waitlistHowItWorks.question: What happens when a category is sold out?
waitlistHowItWorks.answer: If the organizer enabled a waitlist, you can Join waitlist when a category is full. You'll see your queue position and get an email when a spot opens. From My registrations, use Claim spot to complete checkout before the offer expires.

waiverRequirement.question: Do I need to sign a waiver to register?
waiverRequirement.answer: Many events require one or more digital waivers before checkout. You'll read each waiver (HTML and/or PDF) and accept them in the registration wizard. If an organizer updates a waiver later, you may be prompted to re-sign from My registrations.

registrationExtrasAddons.question: What are registration add-ons?
registrationExtrasAddons.answer: Organizers can offer optional extras (merch, meals, services, and more) during registration. You choose quantities per participant; some add-ons ask extra questions or a shipping address. Add-ons are included in your checkout total alongside the category price.

discountCodesAtCheckout.question: Can I use a promo or discount code?
discountCodesAtCheckout.answer: Yes, if the organizer created one. Enter your code at checkout (solo or group orders) and tap Apply before paying. Valid codes reduce your total; invalid or expired codes are rejected with an error message.

registrationEligibility.question: Why can't I select certain categories?
registrationEligibility.answer: Categories can restrict age, gender, or registration window dates. Atleita recommends categories based on your profile date of birth and gender—complete those in Profile if you see eligibility warnings. Registration also closes after the event's registration deadline.

paymentMethodsStripe.question: How do I pay for a registration?
paymentMethodsStripe.answer: Paid registrations are processed securely in Mexican pesos (MXN). Pay with a new card at checkout or use a card saved under Payment methods in your portal. Atleita never stores your full card number.

pricesInMxnAndFees.question: What currency are prices shown in?
pricesInMxnAndFees.answer: Event and add-on prices are shown in Mexican pesos (MXN). Checkout may include a Atleita service fee and IVA in the total; expand the invoice breakdown on the payment step for an itemized preview.

freeEventRegistration.question: Do I need a card for free events?
freeEventRegistration.answer: No. When your category and add-ons total $0 MXN (including a 100% promo), checkout skips card entry and shows your discount and $0 total. You still tap Confirm registration to finish—then you get the confirmation email and QR like any other registration.

refundsAndCancellations.question: How do refunds and cancellations work?
refundsAndCancellations.answer: Refunds are issued by the organizer or Atleita staff, not self-service in the athlete portal. Contact the event organizer or Atleita support via the Contact page. Refunded registrations show as Refunded in your portal.

createAthleteAccount.question: How do I create or sign in to my athlete account?
createAthleteAccount.answer: Go to Login and enter your email. Sign in with a password, use social sign-in when enabled, or create a new profile. Your athlete portal holds registrations, results, teams, and payment methods.

completeAthleteProfile.question: Why is Atleita asking me to complete my profile?
completeAthleteProfile.answer: Date of birth and gender are used to recommend eligible categories and validate restrictions at checkout. If either is missing, you may be redirected to Complete profile before finishing registration. Update details anytime under Profile.

qrCheckInCode.question: Where is my check-in QR code?
qrCheckInCode.answer: After confirmation, open My registrations in your portal and tap View QR on any active registration. Show that code at packet pickup or race-day check-in—it encodes your unique registration token and displays your folio (and bib when assigned).

transferRegistration.question: Can I transfer my registration to someone else?
transferRegistration.answer: Yes, for eligible confirmed registrations. In My registrations, use Transfer and enter the recipient's email. They'll receive instructions to accept the transfer into their Atleita account. Only one pending transfer is allowed per registration at a time.

hostEventOnAtleita.question: I want to organize a race—where do I start?
hostEventOnAtleita.answer: Visit Host an event to learn how Atleita handles registrations, secure payments, and QR check-in. Tap Start free to begin self-service organizer signup; events are reviewed before appearing on the public marketplace.

contactAthleteSupport.question: How do I contact Atleita for help?
contactAthleteSupport.answer: Visit the Contact page for athlete support: support email, phone, WhatsApp, and office details from our public site profile. Use this for registration, payment, or account questions. Organizers have a separate onboarding path at Host an event.

paymentsUnavailableForEvent.question: Why can't I pay online for a paid category?
paymentsUnavailableForEvent.answer: If the organizer hasn't finished payout setup, paid categories may show online payment temporarily unavailable while free categories can still work. Check back later or contact the organizer—the event page explains when payouts are still being configured.
